item.name: Gets a list of all ManagementStations in a compartment

request.name: Gets a list of all ManagementStations in a compartment

description.content:
Lists management stations within the specified compartment. Filter the list against a variety of criteria 
including but not limited to name, status, and location.

query.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the resources to list. This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.
A filter to return resources that match the given user-friendly name.
A filter to return resources that may partially match the given display name.
A filter that returns information for management stations in the specified state.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance. This filter returns resources associated with this managed instance.

For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`
A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.
A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.
A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.
A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.
The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified timeCreated is default.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the management station. A filter that returns information about the specified management station.
A filter that returns information for management stations in the specified health state.

info.name: OS Management Hub Management Station API

description.content:
Use the OS Management Hub API to manage and monitor updates and patches for instances in OCI, your private data center, or 3rd-party clouds. 
For more information, see [Overview of OS Management Hub](https://docs.cloud.oracle.com/iaas/osmh/doc/overview.htm).
